example_en: The child called out 'amma' in its imperfect speech.

definition: the act, manner or power of flying or moving through space (as of birds, aircrafts, etc.); flight.
example: ಹಳೆಗನ್ನಡ ಕಾವ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಹಾಱಾಟ ಎಂಬ ಪದ ಹಾರಾಟ ಎಂಬ ಅರ್ಥದಲ್ಲಿ ಬಳಕೆಯಾಗಿದೆ.
example_en: In old Kannada poetry, the word 'hāṟāṭa' is used to mean flight.

definition: to speak of or treat slightingly; to depreciate, belittle; to disparage.
example: ಅವಳು ತನ್ನ ಸ್ನೇಹಿತನನ್ನು ಜನರ ಮುಂದೆ ಹೀನಾಯವಾಡಿದಳು.
example_en: She belittled her friend in front of everyone.

definition: a communication passed or sent (in writing, by signals, etc.); a message.
example_en: The messenger brought the king's message.

definition: a flow of water in a canal.
example_en: During the rainy season, the flow of water in the canal ran strongly.

definition: to rule; to govern; to reign.
example_en: That king ruled his subjects with justice.

definition: rebirth of a soul in another body; reincarnation.
example: ಸತ್ತ ಮೇಲೆ ಪ್ರತ್ಯುದ್ಭವವು ಉಂಟಾಗುತ್ತದೆ ಎಂದು ಅವರು ನಂಬುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: They believe that after death, rebirth in another body occurs.

definition: pressed out; extracted (said of juice from a fruit, herb, etc.).
example_en: The juice of this fruit is freshly extracted.

definition: to taken in to one's hand; to receive; to accept.
example_en: She accepts the gift happily.

definition: the supreme authority; sovereignty.
example_en: The king's sovereignty extended over the whole kingdom.

definition: an ear-ring with a hanging.
example_en: The hanging earring on her ear shone in the light.

definition: confidence in oneself, one's own abilities etc.; self-confidence.
example_en: One without self-confidence does not achieve success.

definition: the hypothetical slow drifting apart of land masses as a result of currents in the molten rocks of the earth's mantle; continental drift.
example_en: Scientists explained the theory of continental drift.

definition: the act of holding (with one's hands).
example_en: When the grip on the rope loosened, the bucket fell.

definition: the fact of being a resident of or living in a place for a relatively longer time.
example: ಆತನ ವಾಸ್ತವ್ಯ ಈ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಹಲವು ವರ್ಷಗಳಿಂದ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: His residence in this town had been for many years.

definition: to redeem or cause to redeem the pawn from the contract of pledge.
example: ಅವನು ಸಾಲ ತೀರಿಸಿ ಒತ್ತಿಟ್ಟ ನಗವನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಿವಿಡಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: He paid off the debt and redeemed the pledged gold.

definition: the surge plant Euphorbia nivulea of Euphorbiaceae plant, grown in the hedges; spiral leaf milk hedge.
example_en: The farmers grew hedge milk-plant around the field.

definition: a mark, usu. a small vertical line on the forehead, made with sandal wood or black unguents.
example_en: She put a mark on her forehead.

definition: to put to some practical or specific use.
example_en: This rule applies to all circumstances.

definition: to cause (morals) to deteriorate.
example_en: Bad company caused his morals to deteriorate.

definition: imitation i.e. a) the act of seeking to follow the example of; a taking ofsomeone or something as one's model or pattern; b) acting the same as; a following the appearance of another; impersonation; c) (in art) reproduction in form, colour, etc.; act of making a duplicate or copy of: 2) the state, fact or quality of resembling; similarity of appearance or, sometimes, of character; likeness.
example_en: That sculpture was an imitation of the original artwork.

definition: sound - a) vibrations in air, water, etc. that stimulate the auditory nerves and produce the sensation of hearing; b) the auditory sensation produced by such vibrations.
example_en: The sound of the drum was heard from afar.

definition: a weapon, such as a sword, knife, dagger, etc. (that is held firmly while using unlike an arrow, spear etc. which is either shot or thrown).
example_en: There was a gleaming hand-held weapon in the soldier's hand.

definition: at a later time; subsequently; afterward.
example_en: Subsequently the king summoned his ministers.

definition: joy; pleasure; delight.
example_en: Everyone found pleasure in the good meal.

definition: the state of the mind, caused by excess joy, awe, fear, ghastliness, etc. characterised by light but continuous vibration of the body with the hairs being erect.
example: ಭಯದಿಂದ ಅವನ ಮೈಯಲ್ಲಿ ಜುಂ ಎಂಬ ಅನುಭವ ಉಂಟಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Out of fear, a shiver of jum ran through his body.

definition: a small quantity of liquid that is somewhat spherical, as when falling; a drop.
example: ಎಲೆಯಿಂದ ಒಂದು ಕಳಿಕೆ ನೀರು ಕೆಳಗೆ ಬಿತ್ತು.
example_en: A drop of water fell down from the leaf.

definition: a pump operated by hand; a hand-pump.
example_en: They used a hand-pump to draw water from the well.

definition: (beauty) to become conspicuous.
example_en: With the flowers in her hair, her beauty became conspicuous.

definition: the utterance in the presence of another person, of a false statement or statements, damaging to a third person's character or reputation; slandering.
example: ಅವನ ಚಾಹಡ ಮಾತು ಕೇಳಿ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಸುಮ್ಮನಾದರು.
example_en: Hearing his slanderous words, everyone fell silent.

definition: to cause to say, utter something or make a statement.
example_en: The teacher made the student recite the lesson.

definition: a similar name.
example_en: Those two villages had a similar name.
